entities.name: Sabina Küller
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anna Sabina Lambertz Küller is a Swedish ice hockey official, retired ice hockey player, and former member of the Swedish national ice hockey team. She played the entirety of her senior club career with AIK IF and served as the team's captain from 2016 until her retirement in 2022.
